title: Lumberjack on a road
instruction: A lumberjack's hut stands roaded to your castle beside a wood. Watch one full cycle: the serf leaving, his pace tile-to-tile, the door transition, and a tree felled.
result: He WALKS (no teleport), at a deliberate ~247 ticks/tile, slides through the door, and fells a tree in five visible stages leaving a stump.
